title: Suspending a Space does not stop its email: its broadcasts, scheduled campaigns and drips still send, and so do the jobs it had already queued

source.ref: deliverSpaceCampaign and runSpaceCampaignEmail never read spaces.status; found drafting the Space email AUP (LIVE-707, PR #3066); ADR-1662

detail:
FILED 2026-09-29 by the LIVE-707 builder while drafting the Space email acceptable-use policy (PR #3066): the AUP says a suspended Space stops sending, and the code did not.

PREMISE, re-tested on main at 60567b67e. Staff suspend a Space from /admin/spaces/[id] (setSpaceStatus flips spaces.status to suspended). Member-facing reads wall it (getVisibleSpaceBySlug returns null for anything not active), but the email path resolves the Space by id through getSpaceById, which reads every status on purpose, and nothing between it and sendRawEmail read status. So the scheduled-campaign cron, the drip runner, the event Manage broadcast, the owner composer (campaigns.ts and email-drafts.ts sendSpaceEmailDraft) and the bulk jobs already queued in the outbox (staggered over hours by bulkRunAfter) all kept sending for a suspended Space. The member composer conversation send (sendSpaceEmailDraftAsConversations, a use-server action keyed by space id) had the same gap. Automations only enroll into drips.

THE ASK. A suspended (or archived) Space sends nothing; mail it had queued is cancelled with a visible reason or held, never dropped silently; drip contacts keep their place so reactivation resumes them.

CLOSED 2026-09-29 (ADR-1662). WHAT CLOSED IT: spaceEmailHold(status) in lib/spaces/email.ts is the one fail-closed decision (only active sends). deliverSpaceCampaign, the path both sendSpaceCampaign and sendSpaceCampaignSystem take, refuses a Space that is not active before anything is queued or ledgered (logged space_email.refused_space_not_active). runSpaceCampaignEmail, the single place a Space campaign email reaches the provider, re-reads the Space status right before sendRawEmail (the job carries spaceId; an older job resolves it through its outreach_sends row); a Space that is not active cancels the job, moving the ledger row queued to failed with the reason (logged space_email.drain_skipped_space_not_active); a status read error throws so the outbox retries and nothing sends. The drip runner holds instead of stopping on that refusal: back to enrolled at the same step, due again in an hour (SPACE_HOLD_RECHECK_MS), logged cron.space_drips.held_space_not_active; DripRunResult gains held. sendSpaceEmailDraftAsConversations carries its own copy of the gate. A scheduled campaign due during a suspension is stamped failed with the refusal as send_error. No migration. Tests: lib/spaces/email.test.ts, lib/spaces/drip-runner.test.ts, lib/spaces/email-drafts.test.ts (new).

verify.note: Fails on main (no spaceEmailHold). Measures: the pure status decision run in-process (only active sends; suspended, archived, unreadable hold); the delivery core refuses before enqueue and every job carries its spaceId; the drain handler cancels onto the ledger before sendRawEmail; the drip runner holds at the same step instead of stopping; the conversation composer refuses before it opens a conversation. Each arm mutation-checked.
